bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
current=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
candidate=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr62-candidate
rollback=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-pr62-20261120
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
running="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" || exit 62
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 63
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = deploy || exit 64
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = gaybbs || exit 65
original="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$current")" || exit 66
test "$original" = "$running" || exit 67
next="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$candidate")" || exit 68
test "$next" != "$original" || exit 69
test ! "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$rollback" 2>/dev/null)" || exit 70
# Keep the exact running image reachable, even if the mutable local tag changes.
docker tag "$original" "$rollback"
restore(){
  docker tag "$rollback" "$current"
  docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap restore ERR
docker tag "$candidate" "$current"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
sleep 8
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$next"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null
trap - ERR
echo LINK_PR62_PRODUCTION_IMAGE=VERIFIED
echo LINK_PR62_ROLLBACK_IMAGE=RETAINED
echo USERBOT_UNCHANGED=VERIFIED
